verdict.rationale: SigNoz is documented as an OpenTelemetry-native platform. Applications emit telemetry through standard OpenTelemetry libraries and SDKs and export it over OTLP, so instrumentation stays vendor-neutral rather than tied to SigNoz-specific agents. Community users also cite its OpenTelemetry basis as a draw. Backend portability is implied by the OTLP/OTel model but is not explicitly documented. missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation that instrumented code can be pointed at another backend without changes, independent hands-on corroboration of switching backends.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can instrument once with open standards and switch backends without re-instrumenting my code

citations.quote: SigNoz Cloud brings your traces, metrics, and logs into one OpenTelemetry-native platform.
Your application emits gen_ai.* spans and metrics through standard OpenTelemetry libraries, exports them over OTLP
